definitions.explanation: A fence or boundary wall built from wooden boards, traditionally seen enclosing houses and gardens in Japan.

examples.english: There is a wooden fence around the house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{板塀|いたべい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{所々|ところどころ}→所々：04009_tokorodokoro⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}いている→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧。
examples.english: The old wooden fence is leaning in places.

examples.japanese: ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黒|くろ}い→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧{板塀|いたべい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町並|まちな}み→町並み：10435_machinami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Black wooden fences lined both sides of the alley, preserving the old-fashioned townscape.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧ (board) + ⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧ (fence, wall); へい voices to べい. Refers specifically to a fence made of wooden boards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {板塀|いたべい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: enclose with a wooden fence
- {板塀|いたべい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}く→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧: the wooden fence leans

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ブロック{塀|べい}→ブロック塀：28373_burokkubei⟧: concrete block wall — made of concrete blocks rather than boards.
- ⟦{垣根|かきね}→垣根：00149_kakine⟧: hedge, fence — often a living hedge or light fence, lighter than a solid {塀|べい}.
